_note: A Map v3 region (MAP_README.md). bbox [west, south, east, north] in degrees; the projection is a transverse Mercator centred on it. osm: the OpenStreetMap extract to clip it from (Geofabrik), and the fallback when that can't be downloaded (Overture's OSM-derived data, rebuilt as an .osm.pbf). dem: elevation sources, best first; each a bare-earth DTM (never a surface model) with its horizontal and vertical datum, converted to EGM2008 heights; blendBand: metres over which a better source fades into the next. spots: quick-travel places (auto: found in the data).
